crossRefs.note: The north wind produces rain; so a backbiting tongue brings an angry face.
“Now deck yourself with excellency and dignity. Array yourself with honor and majesty.
Yours, Yahweh, is the greatness, the power, the glory, the victory, and the majesty! For all that is in the heavens and…
Yahweh’s voice is powerful. Yahweh’s voice is full of majesty.
Come, and see God’s deeds— awesome work on behalf of the children of men.
God, when you went out before your people, when you marched through the wilderness...
The earth trembled. The sky also poured down rain at the presence of the God of Sinai— at the presence of God, the God…
He will cut off the spirit of princes. He is feared by the kings of the earth.
Yahweh reigns! He is clothed with majesty! Yahweh is armed with strength. The world also is established. It can’t be…
Bless Yahweh, my soul. Yahweh, my God, you are very great. You are clothed with honor and majesty.
I will meditate on the glorious majesty of your honor, on your wondrous works.
Enter into the rock, and hide in the dust, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from the glory of his majesty.
Men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Yahweh, and from…
He shall stand, and shall shepherd in the strength of Yahweh, in the majesty of the name of Yahweh his God: and they…
Yahweh is slow to anger, and great in power, and will by no means leave the guilty unpunished. Yahweh has his way in…
God came from Teman, the Holy One from Mount Paran. His glory covered the heavens, and his praise filled the earth.
His Son is the radiance of his glory, the very image of his substance, and upholding all things by the word of his…
for our God is a consuming fire.
to God our Savior, who alone is wise, be glory and majesty, dominion and power, both now and forever. Amen.

translations.web: Out of the north comes golden splendor. With God is awesome majesty.
translations.bsb: Out of the north He comes in golden splendor; awesome majesty surrounds Him.
translations.kjv: Fair weather cometh out of the north: with God is terrible majesty.
translations.asv: Out of the north cometh golden splendor: God hath upon him terrible majesty.
